import requests
from math import log
from probabilistic_model import estimate_prob

def get_clay_problem_data(problem_name):
    data = requests.get(f'http://claymath.org/problems/{problem_name}/data').json()
    return data

def preprocess_request_data(request_data):
    processed_data = {}
    for key, val in request_data.items():
        processed_data[key] = val/100
    return processed_data

def compute_prob(problem, request_data):
    request_data = preprocess_request_data(request_data)
    data = get_clay_problem_data(problem)

    time_span = "3-5 years"
    prob = estimate_prob(data, problem, request_data, time_span)
    return prob
